theorems.name: Submission.dph_sh_ib_covectorEuclideanNorm_contract_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (p k : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Eucl p) (k + 1)) (w : Eucl p) (δ : Covector (Eucl p) k), (∀ u : Fin k → Eucl p, δ u = γ (Fin.cons w u)) → covectorEuclideanNorm δ ≤ Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖w‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm γ
